abstract: |
  This proposal outlines the intended research for the term paper in CIV-E-665, focusing on the application of smart concrete and machine learning techniques for monitoring the curing process of concrete structures. The study aims to explore the integration of IoT sensors with self-sensing concrete to enhance real-time monitoring capabilities, ultimately improving construction quality and durability.
---

Key words: Smart Concrete, Machine Learning, Curing Monitoring, IoT Sensors, Self-Sensing.
